status: PROVISIONAL: selected metadata frozen; index origin and decoder join require independently reviewed witness before source qualification
frame_index_basis: third-party code maps integer annotation keys to zero-based OpenCV read index; author-origin and actual footage join not independently verified
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, stated on OpenTTGames author homepage
source_archive_hash_basis: seven label zip hashes rechecked in metadata scan; video hashes and 120/1 fps from existing inventory, not reread
prior_exposure: all seven videos used in G1e motion-floor study
cost: proposal only; <=180 GPU-s / <=300 workload CPU-s, subject to root approval, measured smoke and forecast
label_semantics: Author homepage defines (-1,-1) as ball absent; single missing coordinate conservatively treated as unknown.
label_reliability: A third-party audit reports potential false absence in test_7; counts describe given labels, not independent verification.

selection_crosscheck.method: independent enumeration of candidate starts from absent-label intervals with binary searches on known labels; matched all seven eligible counts, selected starts and hashes

fps_precision: 120/1 is the recorded container average / nominal metadata and is not an independent constant-frame-rate proof.
